intent: The default left-rail content: a draggable vertical split of the Slides list over the Layers tree.
guidance: Presentational only — the editor owns slide/layer data and persists both the split ratio (onSplitChange) and the panel width (onWidthChange). Split and width are each controlled or uncontrolled; the split defaults to ~40% slides over ~60% layers and each pane keeps an 80px minimum. The divider is an invisible 4px hit area on the top edge of the layers pane (ns-resize cursor, no visible handle); Arrow Up/Down nudge it 2% for keyboard users. Width lives in SidePanel so Composition, Assets, and Agent share one rail width across tab switches. Renders light by default, dark under an ancestor data-composa-mode='dark'. Wire the slide and layer callbacks through to the editor's data model and undo.

anatomy.description: Top pane (~40%): the inline-rename project-title combo header, the New slide button, and the scrolling slide-thumbnail list (SlidesPanel).
Draggable horizontal separator on the top edge of the layers pane — invisible 4px hit area, ns-resize cursor, no visible handle; drag or arrow-nudge to change the two panes' relative heights.
Bottom pane (fills the rest, ~60%): the Figma-style layer tree (LayerList).
Invisible vertical separator on the panel's right edge (owned by SidePanel) that drags the whole rail's width.

use_when: You need the default left rail: a project's slides above its layers in one resizable column.
You want the slides/layers heights to be user-adjustable via a draggable divider.
dont_use_when: You only need the layer tree or only the slide list — render LayerList or SlidesPanel directly.
For the Assets or Agent left-rail tabs — those wrap SidePanel with their own content.
For the right-rail property inspector — use Inspector.

surface.border: border/default (c-border — right rail divider, via SidePanel)

resize.handle: border/selected at 40% (c-border-selected/40 — split-divider focus + width-handle drag)

tokens.note: DEMO_SLIDES thumbnails carry hardcoded hex tints (#4f46e5, #0ea5e9, #f59e0b, #10b981, #34d399, #6ee7b7, #ef4444, #8b5cf6); the 4px divider hit area, 80px pane minimum, ~0.4 default split, and 240px default width are literal px.

a11y.role: Presentational split container (no landmark on the root); both resize dividers render role=separator.
a11y.split: Horizontal separator — aria-orientation=horizontal, aria-label 'Resize slides and layers', aria-valuenow/min/max (0–100), tabIndex 0; Arrow Up/Down nudge 2%.
a11y.width: Vertical separator on the right edge (SidePanel) — aria-orientation=vertical, aria-label 'Resize panel width', aria-valuenow/min/max, Arrow Left/Right nudge 8px.
a11y.theme: Theme-aware — light by default, dark under an ancestor data-composa-mode='dark'.

code.example:
<CompositionPanel
  slides={slides}
  layers={layers}
  selectedLayerId={selectedId}
  onLayerSelectionChange={setSelectedId}
  split={split}
  onSplitChange={setSplit}
  width={railWidth}
  onWidthChange={setRailWidth}
/>
